scientific_integrity: The proof is parameter-uniform and mathematical. Enumerations n=4..10 independently check the dual and n=4..8 check the ordinary complex. Independent external validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats ordinary 3-cut complexes of the cubic Möbius ladder for n>=4; no higher k, total cut, integral equivariant structure, or broader cubic-graph classification is asserted. Source overlap risk for unpublished or unindexed results is not eliminated.
title: Ordinary three-cut complexes of Möbius ladders are wedges of top-dimensional spheres
